evidence: Production FileScopes/GalleryPublisher publish a unique synthetic PNG. CompanionUi first checks visual touch in a normal App, then attempts real DocumentsUI visual touch and uses the currently advertised semantic click if selection did not occur. A separate receiving App verifies the full SHA256. UiAutomation only discovers targets and reads results, never clicks this picker. Accepted gestures without selection remain recorded. Authorization and transport are fixture substitutes; no physical-phone, relay or personal-AI acceptance claimed.
